slides.title: Introduction.
slides.body: Power, flow and renewal: an identity drawn from falling water.

slides.label: Positioning
slides.heading: Building Europe's first bankable AI infrastructure platform
slides.body: Pure AI power, shaped by clarity, sustainability and control.

slides.label: The name
slides.heading: Energy converging into intelligence
slides.body: Fossefall takes its identity from the waterfall. The vertical drop stands for gravity and continuous motion; the interlocking S in the logo for waterfalls and data streams meeting.

slides.title: From infrastructure builder to full-stack compute platform

slides.heading: More than data centre sites
slides.body: Every SPV Fossefall develops contributes to one consolidated infrastructure base: the foundation of a full-stack AI compute platform.
